meta.parties: Eliyatamby Et Al. v. Kanapathy Veeragathie

rules.statement: The Partition Ordinance does not contemplate partitioning more than one land in a single proceeding unless those lands are held in common by the same set of co-owners in the same proportions.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is not contemplated by the provisions of the Partition Ordinance that any more than one land will be partitioned in one proceeding. An exception may be made in cases in which more than one allotment of land are held in common by the same set of co-owners in the same proportions."
